listing.title: Home Bakery and Cake Business Recipe Costing and Pricing Excel Template: Cost per Serving, Cake Quote Builder, Margin by Product
listing.headline: Know what every cake costs and what to charge before you quote
listing.description:
Price every cake, box and loaf from its recipe in one Excel workbook. Recipe lines take today's ingredient prices, and Products shows the ingredient, packaging, labour and energy cost, the margin, the cost per serving and the price you need for your target margin for all 24 products. Margin targets mark every product and order that falls below your goal.

Cake sizes, Decoration levels and the Custom cake quote give you cost, price, delivery fee, margin, deposit and sales tax for a cake of any size, flavour and decoration. The Tiered cake planner turns a guest count into the right cake size with kilograms of sponge, filling and frosting, and the Event cake guide lists sizes by guests.

Ingredients, Ingredient price changes and Price changes show what a butter or flour rise does to every product and when each price last changed. Wholesale price list (selling to cafes and shops at a lower price), Competitor price checks and Seasonal price rules help you set prices you can defend, while Orders profit sample, Cost by month and Labour time log show where margin is lost.

14 calculators cover recipe cost, the cake quote, tiers, scaling a recipe, target price, ingredient rise, labour and decoration, energy per bake, boxes and bundles, wholesale margin, deposit, discount impact, break-even and a what-if grid. Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow 10 checklists and send 28 ready messages with the details already written in.

This is part one of the Home Bakery and Cake Business suite. A standard Excel workbook with no macros and no subscription, 15 languages in one purchase, with a demo copy full of sample data to explore first. Money is shown in one plain currency. It helps you plan and does not promise results.

signature.name: Recipe costing with live ingredient prices
signature.why: every recipe line takes today's price per kilogram or piece, so a butter or flour change reaches every product cost at once

signature.name: Cost per serving for every product
signature.why: ingredient, packaging, labour and energy add up to the total cost, the profit per unit, the margin and the cost per serving of all 24 products

signature.name: Custom cake quote by size, tiers and decoration
signature.why: choose size, flavour, decoration and zone and see cost, price, delivery fee, margin, deposit and sales tax before you answer the client

signature.name: Tiered cake planner by guest count
signature.why: type the guests and see the smallest cake that serves them with its tiers, kilograms of sponge, filling and frosting and cost per serving

signature.name: Price from target margin
signature.why: set a margin for each product category and see the price you need, the rise still missing and the products below target

signature.name: Ingredient price rise impact on every product
signature.why: a test rise on one ingredient shows the extra cost and the margin left for every product and the cost across all recipes

signature.name: Wholesale price and margin check
signature.why: the wholesale discount, the margin per unit and a flag when cafes and shops pay a price below your wholesale margin goal

signature.name: Competitor price gap
signature.why: your price against a local shop and a home baker for each product, with the latest check marked and the gap to the average

signature.name: Labour time against plan
signature.why: planned and real minutes of each job show the gap in hours and money, so a decoration that always runs long gets a new price

signature.name: Seasonal price rules
signature.why: uplifts for busy weeks and discounts for slow weeks with dates, products and an active, starting soon or ended status

signature.name: Order profit sample with loss check
signature.why: each order shows profit and margin against the category target, so a three-tier cake priced below its cost stands out

signature.name: Cost by month for every product
signature.why: ingredient cost at each month's prices and the list price then give a monthly margin that shows how costs slowly eat the margin

competitors.lacks: costs one recipe at a time with typed prices; no margin per category, no quote builder, no price rise impact and no order profit check
charges every month for many features while the cake quote by size and decoration and the cost per serving stay shallow
lists orders and totals but has no recipe lines, no ingredient prices and cannot tell you the margin of an order or a product
adds up spending by month but never connects an ingredient price to the price of a cake or a box

competitors.what: paper notebook of recipes and prices
competitors.lacks: loses old prices, forgets which ingredient rose and cannot show which products are below your target margin

messages.text: Hello {client}, a smaller cake than the {servings} servings in quote {quote_id} would lower the price. Shall we send a new quote?

messages.text: Hello {client}, our prices change after {valid_until}. Your quote {quote_id} stays at {quoted_price} until then.

messages.moment: Client: a deposit secures your date
messages.text: Hello {client}, a deposit of {deposit} secures your date for quote {quote_id}. The balance is paid at pick-up or delivery.

messages.moment: Client: your quote with your decoration
messages.text: Hello {client}, quote {quote_id} includes the {decoration} decoration you chose: {quoted_price} for {product}.

messages.moment: Client: a cupcake price for your event
messages.text: Hello {client}, for your event the price of {product} is {quoted_price} for {servings} servings. Boxes can be ordered in more than one flavour.

messages.moment: Client: a cookie price for your party
messages.text: Hello {client}, the price of {product} for your party is {quoted_price}. We can add a label or a ribbon on request.

messages.moment: Client: your quote is accepted
messages.text: Hello {client}, thank you for accepting quote {quote_id}. We will confirm the date and the details of {product} shortly.

messages.moment: Client: a larger cake for your guests
messages.text: Hello {client}, if more guests come than the {servings} servings in quote {quote_id}, a larger size avoids a shortage. Shall we price it?

messages.moment: Client: the seasonal menu and prices
messages.text: Hello {client}, our seasonal menu and prices are ready. Order early in busy weeks so that we can keep your date.

messages.moment: Client: a bundle offer for your order
messages.text: Hello {client}, adding a box of cupcakes or cookies to quote {quote_id} gives you a better price for both. Would you like to see it?

messages.moment: Account: the new wholesale prices
messages.text: Hello {account}, the new wholesale price of {product} is {wholesale_price} from {valid_from}. Please confirm that you received it.

messages.moment: Account: a price change on butter items
messages.text: Hello {account}, butter prices rose and the price of {product} changes to {wholesale_price} from {valid_from}. Thank you for your understanding.

messages.moment: Account: your standing order price
messages.text: Hello {account}, your standing order price for {product} is {wholesale_price}. Tell us if you want to change the weekly units.

messages.moment: Account: a trial price for a new product
messages.text: Hello {account}, we would like you to try {product} at {wholesale_price} for a month. Please tell us if you want to start.

messages.moment: Supplier: please confirm today's price
messages.text: Hello, please confirm today's price for {item}. Our list shows {new_cost}. Thank you.

messages.moment: Supplier: your price rose, fix it for us

messages.moment: Supplier: a larger order, what discount
messages.text: Hello, we plan a larger order of {item}. What discount can you offer on {new_cost} per unit?

messages.moment: Supplier: a quote for new boxes
messages.text: Hello, please send a quote for new boxes and labels. Your current price for {item} is {new_cost}. Thank you.

messages.moment: Team: the recipe for a product changed
messages.text: Hello {baker}, the recipe for {product} changed: {change_tried}. Please follow the new recipe from the next bake.

messages.moment: Team: weigh the new portion size
messages.text: Hello {baker}, please weigh the new portion of {product} on the next bake and tell us the result.

messages.moment: Team: check the labour time for a job
messages.text: Hello {baker}, {product} took {minutes_actual} minutes against {minutes_planned} planned. Please tell us what slowed the job.

messages.moment: Owner: a margin fell below target

messages.moment: Owner: a rise may need a price change

Review the list prices, the recipe costs and the ingredient prices of this category at least once a year. Prices that were not changed in 12 months are marked on the Products sheet.
Check your own local rules on how long to keep your cost records.

ar.each order shows profit and margin again: يُظهر كل طلب ربحًا وهامشًا مقابل الفئة المستهدفة، لذلك تبرز كعكة من ثلاث طبقات بسعر أقل من تكلفتها
ar.ingredient cost at each month's prices a: تكلفة المكونات بأسعار كل شهر وقائمة الأسعار ثم قم بإعطاء هامش شهري يوضح كيف تأكل التكاليف الهامش ببطء

ar.Days without a reply before a quote need: أيام دون رد قبل أن يحتاج عرض الأسعار إلى متابعة

ar.Cost of one kilogram of filling and fros: تكلفة كيلو جرام من الحشوة والكريمة

ar.One row for each ingredient or packaging: صف واحد لكل مكون أو عنصر تعبئة في الوصفة، بالجرام أو القطع؛ تأتي تكلفة الوحدة من المكونات ويتم ملء تكلفة الخط وحصته من تكلفة المنتج بأنفسهم.

ar.Cake sizes with sponge, filling and fros: أحجام الكيك بتكلفة الإسفنج والحشوة والزينة
ar.The 12 cake sizes with servings, tiers,: أحجام الكيك الـ 12 مع الحصص والطبقات والكيلوجرامات من الإسفنج والحشوة والزينة ودقائق الخبز والتجميع؛ تكلفة المواد والعمالة والطاقة وتكلفة كل وجبة.
ar.Decoration levels with price and labour: مستويات الديكور مع عوامل السعر والعمالة

ar.One row for each change of a list price: صف واحد لكل تغيير في قائمة الأسعار مع السعر القديم والجديد والسبب؛ التغيير في الأموال والنسبة المئوية للملء، وتاريخ التغيير الأخير يغذي المنتجات.

ar.Oven programs with the energy cost of on: برامج الفرن مع تكلفة الطاقة لمخبز واحد
ar.The 14 oven programs with minutes, tray: 14 برنامجًا للفرن مع الدقائق وأحمال الصينية والطاقة بالكيلووات؛ الكيلوواط ساعة المستخدمة، وتكلفة الطاقة لمخبز واحد، وتكلفة تعبئة حمولة صينية واحدة.
ar.The margin you want in each product cate: الهامش الذي تريده في كل فئة من فئات المنتجات؛ يتم ملء عدد المنتجات الموجودة أدناه ويتم فحص كل منتج وطلب مقابله.

ar.Packaging items with the price from each: عناصر التعبئة والتغليف بالسعر من كل مورد
ar.The boxes, boards, bags and labels you u: الصناديق والألواح والحقائب والملصقات التي تستخدمها مع تكلفة كل منها والمورد؛ خطوط الوصفة والأحجام ترفع هذه التكاليف.

ar.The price uplifts or discounts you apply: رفع الأسعار أو الخصومات التي تطبقها في الأسابيع المزدحمة والبطيئة، مع تأثر التواريخ والمنتجات؛ املأ الحالة ومثال لسعر الفئة.
ar.Competitor price checks against local sh: فحص أسعار المنافسين ضد المتاجر المحلية والخبازين المنزليين
ar.One row for each price check with your p: صف واحد لكل فحص سعر يتضمن السعر الخاص بك، وسعر المتجر المحلي، وسعر الخباز المنزلي؛ قم بملء الفجوة إلى متوسطها وموقعك، مع وضع علامة على آخر شيك لكل منتج.
ar.Recipe tests with the cost change and th: اختبارات الوصفة مع تغير التكلفة ودرجة الذوق
ar.One row for each recipe change you tried: صف واحد لكل تغيير في الوصفة قمت بتجربته مع تغيير التكلفة لكل وحدة، ودرجة الطعم والقرار؛ يتم ملء هاتف الخباز والتكلفة كنسبة من تكلفة المكونات.
ar.Ingredient cost and margin of every prod: تكلفة المكونات وهامش كل منتج حسب الشهر
ar.One row for each product and month with: صف واحد لكل منتج وشهر مع تكلفة المكونات بأسعار ذلك الشهر وقائمة الأسعار بعد ذلك؛ الهامش والتغيير في تكلفة المكونات من الشهر السابق للملء.
ar.Labour time planned against actual: وقت العمل المخطط له مقابل الفعلي
ar.One row for each job with the minutes pl: صف واحد لكل مهمة يتضمن الدقائق المخططة والدقائق التي استغرقتها بالفعل؛ الفجوة بالدقائق والساعات، وتكلفة الفجوة وملء الشيك، وهاتف الخباز جاهز للرسالة.

ar.Type the guests and the servings for eac: اكتب الضيوف والحصص لكل ضيف؛ اطلع على أصغر حجم للكيك الذي يقدم لهم، وطبقاته، وكيلوغرامات الإسفنج، والحشوة والزينة التي يجب تحضيرها، وتكلفة كل حصة.
ar.Recipe scaler to a new batch size: وصفة المتسلق إلى حجم دفعة جديد

ar.Type the old and new price of an ingredi: اكتب السعر القديم والجديد لأحد المكونات، والكيلوجرامات المستخدمة شهريًا، والمبيعات الشهرية للمنتجات التي تستخدمه؛ انظر التكلفة الإضافية وارتفاع الأسعار المطلوب.

ar.Largest discount at your wholesale margi: أكبر خصم على هدف هامش البيع بالجملة الخاص بك

nl.Test recipe changes on Recipe tests: cos: Test receptwijzigingen op Recepttesten: kostenwijziging, smaakscore en de beslissing.
nl.Use the 14 calculators before you quote:: Gebruik de 14 rekenmachines voordat u een offerte maakt: receptkosten, taartofferte, niveaus, scaler, richtprijs, stijging van de ingrediënten, arbeid, energie, dozen, groothandel, statiegeld, korting, break-even en een wat-als-raster.
nl.Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow: Druk 10 vellen en 10 documenten af, volg 10 checklists en tik op een berichtlink om een ​​chat te openen met de reeds geschreven tekst (28 berichten).
nl.Read the Costing and Pricing Dashboard a: Lees elke week de Kosten- en prijsdashboard en de grafieken: marge per categorie, aanvaarding van offertes, wijzigingen in de ingrediëntenprijzen, orderwinst en arbeidstijdverschillen.
nl.Every drop-down list of this file. Renam: Alle keuzelijsten in dit bestand. Wijzig hier een item en de wijziging wordt op elk werkblad doorgevoerd.
nl.Updates itself from your sheets. Change: Wordt bijgewerkt vanuit je werkbladen. Wijzig het jaar om terug te kijken.
nl.Choose in the yellow cell; the rest fill: Kies in de gele cel; de rest wordt automatisch ingevuld. Klaar om af te drukken.
nl.Edit the wording here; words in {braces}: Pas de tekst hier aan; woorden tussen {accolades} worden ingevuld vanuit elke rij. De koppelingen staan in de tabellen.
nl.Choose a record: each step gets its due: Kies een registratie: voor elke stap wordt de uiterste datum berekend. Maak voor elke registratie een kopie van dit werkblad.
nl.Live charts of your sheets. Choose in th: Actuele grafieken op basis van je werkbladen. Kies in de gele cellen en alle grafieken en meters worden automatisch vernieuwd.
